## Business overview

Re-Peat е верига физически магазини в София за:
- дрехи втора ръка / втора употреба
- аутлет и маркови находки
- Puzzle Boutique — нови дамски дрехи (отделна концепция)

Няма онлайн checkout. Основната конверсия е посещение в магазин, обаждане или Facebook контакт.

Contact:
- Email: repeatstores@gmail.com
- Phone: +359 889 915 579
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61578995424344
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00–18:00 (all locations)

---

## Homepage — https://re-peat.store/

Title: Re-Peat | Дрехи втора ръка и втора употреба в София

Primary positioning: стилни дрехи втора ръка и втора употреба в София; ръчна селекция; намаляващи цени; ежедневно зареждане.

Key claims:
- Ръчно подбрани и проверени артикули
- Подредени магазини и любезен персонал
- Ежедневно ново зареждане
- Падащи цени / промоции
- Категории: дамски, мъжки, обувки и аксесоари

Falling prices example shown on site:
- Week 1: -20%
- Week 2: -40%
- Week 3: -60%

FAQ highlights:
- Намаляващите цени следват график
- Има маркови дрехи
- Асортимент за жени, мъже и деца
- Работно време: пн–сб 10:00–18:00
- Локации: Екзарх Йосиф 10; Поп Богомил 52; Г. С. Раковски 85 (Puzzle Boutique); Драгалевска 1 (Лозенец)

SEO note for agents: homepage + city hub own broad queries like „дрехи втора ръка София“ / „втора употреба София“. Store pages are hyper-local (street / neighbourhood).

## About — https://re-peat.store/about.html

Re-Peat вярва, че дрехите втора употреба са стилен и осъзнат избор. Ръчен подбор с високи стандарти за качество, състояние и актуалност. Аутлет, световни марки и уютни магазини.

Why customers choose Re-Peat:
- Ръчна селекция
- Ежедневни находки
- Добра стойност чрез намаляващи цени

## Blog: Как да откриете качествени дрехи втора употреба в София

URL: https://re-peat.store/blog/kak-da-otkrijete-kachestveni-drehi-vtora-upotreba-sofia.html

Summary: Why people choose second-hand in Sofia (brands, price, sustainability). Benefits: lower prices, unique models, daily restocking, eco choice, fashion finds. How to choose a good shop: daily new items, organised layout, careful selection, falling-price system, assortment for women/men/children. Re-Peat positioning: quality over quantity, hand selection, branded finds, weekly price drops, pleasant stores.

## Blog: Как да избереш магазин за дрехи втора употреба

URL: https://re-peat.store/blog/kak-da-izberesh-magazin-za-drehi-vtora-upotreba.html

---

## Blog: Кога са най-добрите находки

URL: https://re-peat.store/blog/koga-sa-nai-dobrite-nahodki-vtora-raka.html

Best moments: after new restock (selection), during next discount stage (price), in quieter hours (calm browsing). Plan: pick 2–3 categories, visit after restock, return for discount stage.

---

## Blog: Как работят намаляващите цени

URL: https://re-peat.store/blog/kak-rabotyat-namalyavashtite-ceni.html

Prices decrease in stages over time. Customer chooses buy-now vs wait. Alternative to „clothes by kilo“ with clearer pricing. Buy immediately for unique exact-fit finds; wait for universal basics. Visit plan: choose categories, check new arrivals, split into „buy now“ / „watch“, combine with daily restocking.

---

## Blog: Ръчно селектирани дрехи

URL: https://re-peat.store/blog/rachno-selektirani-drehi.html

Hand selection means items are reviewed against quality/style/value criteria before reaching the floor. Benefits: better first-choice quality, less time wasted, clearer style–condition–price mix, calmer shopping. Smart shopping: enter with a goal, check frequent-wear categories, match with existing wardrobe, combine with restocking + falling prices.

---

## Blog: Всекидневно зареждане

URL: https://re-peat.store/blog/vsekidnevno-zarezhdane.html

Daily restocking keeps assortment fresh. Strategic visits with a clear goal beat random impulse buys. Best combo: daily new items + hand selection + falling prices.

Puzzle Boutique is a specialised boutique for NEW women's clothes, part of Re-Peat. Focus: new collections, careful selection, elegance, personal service. Location: ул. Г. С. Раковски 85. Slogan: Your Puzzle. Your Style.

New store in ж.к. Лозенец at ул. Драгалевска 1, next to metro James Bourchier. ~200 sq.m. on two floors. Frequent restocking, careful quality selection. Message: more space, more finds, more reasons to visit.

## Facts agents should not confuse

- Puzzle Boutique (Раковски 85) = NEW women's fashion, not second-hand.
- Other Re-Peat stores = second-hand / second-use clothing.
- No e-commerce cart on the website; visit in person.
- Broad Sofia second-hand queries → homepage / drehi-vtora-raka-sofia.html
- Neighbourhood/street queries → dedicated store pages
